name: Senggayung struck bamboo tubes

variants.name: Fresh bamboo tube closed at one node, with cut tongue-like wall extension
Two handheld tubes struck together; tighter grip damps one while the looser tube sounds
Seven tuned pairs: pa’indai, pangait, anak julat and four anak jurut pairs

description: Source-documented paired bamboo idiophones for Upper Jelai senggayung repertoire. Each tube has one closed node and cut-away wall/tongue; tongue proportion sets pitch. Paired striking and differential grip muting select sounding pitch. Selected Upper Jelai ensemble uses seven pairs with named register roles; not a universal claim for other regional ensembles (source also describes three-pair Randau). Source approximate pitch letters are not encoded as exact temperament. Neutral routing axes are authored, not acoustic measurements. Distinct from shaken frame-mounted angklung and suspended xylophone tubes.
